- Carefully scan the entire dialogue history to fill in each attraction slot (area, name, type) whenever the user mentions or requests info (including address/phone/postcode, as this signals information intent for an attraction and thus the attraction-state must be filled).
- DO NOT output anything conversational or textual. The output must be the JSON dictionary with all keys present, and values filled where explicitly provided. Do not miss slots if the user provides them at any turn, even if only asking for address/phone/postcode/etc.
- IGNORE constraints or information about hotels, restaurants, taxis, or trains unless they are DIRECTLY mapped to an explicit ATTRACTION slot. For booking, fill in all ATTRACTION booking-relevant slots only if the user explicitly asks to book an attraction.

</DONT_CHANGE>

WARNING: Only fill ATTRACTION domain slots (area, name, type), and only when the user intention is about an attraction. Never skip explicit mentions or requests for information/postcode/phone/address about an attraction. All slots must be included in the output, using the most recent value if updated. Leave a slot as an empty string ONLY if it has never been mentioned in the whole dialogue for the ATTRACTION domain. NEVER output conversational text or omit the JSON structure.

- When a user makes an information request (asks for address, postcode, phone, etc.), even outside booking context, extract all known hotel slots up to that point.
